title: Night Cream in Summer: Yes or No? A Simple Guide for India
ex: Yes for most people, just lighter and less. How to decide by skin type, humid vs dry heat and AC, and how to use night cream in an Indian summer.
rt: Night Cream in Summer: Yes or No? | Mirc Glow
rd: Night cream in summer: yes or no? For most skin, yes, in a lighter layer. How to decide by skin type, humid or dry heat and AC, plus summer sunscreen tips.
quick: Yes, most people should still use night cream in summer, just a lighter texture and a smaller amount. Skin can lose water overnight under a fan or AC even when it looks oily. Very oily skin in humid heat without AC can use a light gel on some nights. Wear sunscreen every morning.
facts: Shiny skin can still be dehydrated
Use about half to one pea-sized amount in summer
Dry-heat cities often need more cream than humid ones
Sunscreen matters most with kojic acid creams in summer
